text: Hello, and welcome to live coverage of this Premier League fixture from Stamford Bridge, as Chelsea and Fulham face off in the West London Derby.

The 10th-placed Blues may be more than halfway through a hit-and-miss season under Mauricio Pochettino, but are still yet to really click into gear – compounded by a 1-0 loss to second-tier Middlesbrough in their midweek EFL Cup semi-final tie.
However, back-to-back Premier League victories over Crystal Palace and Luton last time out have given Chelsea the chance to climb as high as seventh, should they win all three points here.
Fulham’s second season back in the top-flight has been much more subdued than their first, but the Cottagers still sit a respectable 13th on the ladder, four points behind Chelsea.

A three-game winless streak, in which Marco Silva’s side failed to score a goal, was snapped with a 2-1 win over high-flying Arsenal in their last game, and the Fulham faithful will be hoping they can follow that up with another victory against their local London rivals.

Armando Broja comes in for Noni Madueke in Chelsea’s only change from their EFL Cup first-leg loss to Middlesbrough, and spearheads a front three with Raheem Sterling and Cole Palmer either side of him.
Palmer netted twice in the 3-2 victory over Luton to continue his impressive start to life in a Chelsea shirt.
Fulham were also defeated in their own EFL Cup semi-final, going down 2-1 against Liverpool in the first leg.

On the right-hand side, Kenny Tete and Harry Wilson come in for Timothy Castagne and Bobby De Cordova-Reid respectively, while captain Tom Cairney rounds off the changes to displace Harrison Reed and partner Joao Palhinha in midfield.
The teams are out on the pitch with Stamford Bridge packed to the rafters, and we're almost ready to go in the West London Derby!
Broja will kick off for Chelsea, and we're underway on Fulham Road!
Tete tries to carry the ball out of defence for Fulham, but gets into a tangle with Sterling that leaves both on the deck and Chelsea are given the free-kick.
Chelsea are unbeaten in their last 18 home league games against Fulham, winning 11 and drawing seven since a 2-0 loss in the second tier back in October 1979.
Fernandez's lofted pass down the left channel finds Sterling in the box, but Palhinha races across in cover for Fulham and prevents Gallagher from getting a shot away!

Palhinha has both made (84) and won (44) more tackles than other player in the Premier League this season, while Chelsea's Gallagher has won possession in the final third more often than any other player in the competition in 2023-24 (27).
Colwill bursts clear of Tete to latch onto Sterling's throughball down the line before crossing, but Diop's there on the near post to head clear for Fulham.

BLOCKED!!! Broja dispossesses Robinson on the edge of his own box and Gallagher cuts it back into Fernandez's path, but the Argentine can't get enough power behind his shot and Adarabioyo gets in the way of it!
Sterling cuts inside to shoot from Fernandez's wide pass, but Tete stands his ground well and gets the block in to keep the Blues at bay once more.
OVER!!!! Chelsea are really starting to knock at the door and Fulham can't get the ball away often enough.
One poor clearance is returned by Gallagher from the edge of the box, but his curling shot sails over the crossbar!
Pereira's initial cross ricochets back into his feet off Fernandez, but his second attempt from the edge of the area is just as easily dealt with by Colwill.
Fulham have won just one of their last 23 Premier League games against Chelsea, beating them 2-1 at Craven Cottage last season.
However, the visitors have never won one of these derbies as a Premier League team.
WIDE!!! Sterling frees up Fernandez to cross from the left, and he finds Broja at the near post.
He heads goalwards with plenty of power behind it, but can't direct the effort on target and it whistles past Leno's right-hand post!
Chelsea have won their last two London derbies in the league, as many as they had in their previous 13.
Meanwhile, Fulham are looking to win three consecutive top-flight London derbies for the first time since April 2013.
Sterling takes on Tete once more and looks to beat him around the outside, but the Fulham full-back slides in to put the ball behind for the game's first corner!
Palhinha looks to volley Palmer's delivery away, but the ball skews off his heel and into the area before being collected in the goalmouth by Leno!

SAVED!!! Wilson takes the ball from Caicedo and turns brilliantly away from two more before finding Pereira in support, and he chooses to shoot despite better passing options as Petrovic makes the save in the far corner!
SAVED!!! Robinson flashes a fizzing ball across the face of goal, evading Chelsea's defenders with Wilson arriving at the far post.
The Welshman shoots first-time and gets his effort on target, but Petrovic darts across his line to make the near-post save!
CHANCE!!! Chelsea win the ball high up the field again and Fernandez feeds Broja in the box.
His lay-off for Gallagher is blocked, but it comes wide to the right and Palmer's low shot is saved and held by Leno!

BLOCKED!!! Sterling does brilliantly to evade the challenge of Tete and control Colwill's high ball into the box, but the right-back stays with him and gets a foot in to block the England winger's eventual close-range shot!
Palmer picks out Sterling at the far post with a ball in from the right, but the winger is flagged for offside after beating Adarabioyo in the air.
After no shots on target (despite Chelsea having four attempts alone) in the first 25 minutes, four (two for each side) have been fired off in the last 10!
Robinson looks to cross from Willian's reverse pass to the byline, but his attempt strikes Palmer and bobbles behind for Fulham's first corner of the match.
The corner is played short and clipped centrally into the path of Cairney, who goes for a standing half-volley and sends a looping shot wide of the mark!
Gusto's loose touch sees him dispossessed and he slides in to win the ball back, but gets his challenge all wrong, catching Willian late and picking up the game's first yellow card!
He's had a welcome reception on his return to Stamford Bridge, however that challenge was anything but! The 35-year-old is eventually back to his feet though, and we play on.
After somehow keeping the ball in play at one end, Chelsea come straight up the other and Fernandez's cross-field pass is met by Gusto before Robinson tracks back to dispossess him and clear!
Gusto's lay-off gives Fernandes time and space to shoot, but he can't keep his 25-yard effort down and Leno watches it sail high and wide of the target!
Wilson arrives on the edge of the box and drills a low cross towards the far post, but Silva gets in the way to put it behind before any Fulham attackers can close in.
BLOCKED!!! The initial delivery is half-cleared by Chelsea before dropping to Wilson on the edge of the box, and his volley strikes Caicedo to go behind for another Fulham corner!
We'll play two minutes of added time at Stamford Bridge with both sides still looking for the opener.
Forward come Fulham as Willian tees up Robinson to cross in at the second time of asking.
He does so, and a mix-up between Disasi and Silva almost proves costly until the latter knocks the ball clear!

PENALTY!!! Chelsea are given a golden chance to take the lead here!!! Palmer slips a pass through the crowd and into Sterling's feet, and he's clipped by Diop as he cuts inside the Fulham defender! There's barely any contact, but certainly enough for the referee to point to the spot, and the Blues can go 1-0 up from 12 yards here!

GOOOOOOAAAAAALLL!!! Palmer makes no mistake!!! A drilled, low shot finds the bottom-right corner, sending Leno the wrong way and giving Chelsea a 1-0 lead!!! What a time to put your side in front, and this 21-year-old's stock just carries on soaring!
HALF-TIME: CHELSEA 1-0 FULHAM.

What looked destined to be a goalless first 45 minutes ends with Palmer putting Chelsea 1-0 up from the spot, finally breaching a dogged Fulham defence on the verge of half-time! The Blues had several chances to open the scoring earlier on, with Gallagher, Broja and Fernandez all firing high and wide of the target.
At the other end, Fulham looked dangerous, with Pereira and Wilson both shooting on-target and the latter really testing Petrovic.
Palmer was the only one in blue to draw a save from Fulham goalkeeper Leno, and he sent him the wrong way from 12 yards to give Chelsea the advantage.
Palmer's the only Chelsea player to manage a shot on target so far, putting one into the gloves of Leno and burying the other to open the scoring.

He's also completed a game-high 19 passes in the final third so far, creating a big chance for Sterling, as well as winning possession twice as the Blues look to turn the ball over as high up the pitch as possible.
Jimenez gets the game back underway for Fulham, kicking off the second half with his side trailing 1-0.
Jimenez is clipped right on the edge of Chelsea's box by Silva, giving Fulham a chance to carve out an equalising opportunity here.
The Fulham free-kick is dealt with and Fernandez races away on the counter-attack for Chelsea.
He bypasses Willian before losing the ball after Wilson's lunge from behind, and the Welsh international is booked for the reckless challenge.
Chelsea work the ball into the box through Palmer's fluid movement again, but neither he nor Broja can get a shot away before being crowded out by the Fulham defence!
WIDE!!! Gusto passes inside to Palmer on the edge of the box, who sizes up another shot and sends the ball curling just wide of the far post!
OFF THE POST!!! Broja does superbly to keep possession in the box and holds up Sterling's throughball before linking up with Fernandez.
He clips the ball into the middle where Sterling arrives late, but his glancing header bounces back off the far post and Gusto hammers the rebound wide!
BLOCKED!!! Fulham come straight up the other end and Pereira passes into Willian's path.
The Brazilian runs onto the ball and opens up to shoot, but Disasi gets in the way of it!
Robinson races forward on an underlapping run and cuts a cross back from Willian's throughball.
Jimenez is the target, but the striker mistimes his jump and can only send the ball looping well over the top!
BLOCKED!!! Gusto's drilled cross into the near post is flicked towards goal by Broja, but Adarabioyo sticks out a leg to put the ball behind for a Chelsea corner!
Fernandez runs down a dead end and loses the ball from Tete's challenge, but then slides in late on Cairney and picks up a yellow card for the tackle.

CHANCE!!! The blue shirts fly forward as Palmer sets Gusto up to cross in from the right, but Sterling can't get a shot away after Tete arrives from nowhere to knock it away! Palmer crosses back in towards the far post and engages Leno, but neither the Fulham goalkeeper nor the incoming Broja get a touch on the ball as it goes behind for a goal-kick!
Sterling whips a threatening cross into the packed Fulham box, but Leno wades through the crowd to take it cleanly in the air.
Tete keeps Willian's clipped ball in the field of play and volleys a cross back into the area, but Petrovic has it covered and collects the high ball despite the attention of Jimenez.
Bobby De Cordova-Reid comes on in Fulham's first change of the match, replacing the booked Wilson on the right side of their attack.
Tete also comes off having engaged in one hell of a battle with Sterling, and Timothy Castagne will replace him at right-back for the remainder of this game.
Chelsea' first alteration comes in attack as Noni Madueke comes on for Broja, in a change that could well see Palmer or Sterling move into a central striking role.
CHANCE!!! Madueke and Palmer combine to put Gallagher through on goal, but he takes a poor touch on the turn allowing Leno to dive on the loose ball!
OVER!!! A poor touch from Palmer robs him of a sensational shot on the turn, but Chelsea keep on coming as Silva thunders in to win possession back for the Blues.
Madueke's cross is deflected into the path of Colwill, but he can't keep his first-time shot down and skews it over the bar!

Chelsea are unbeaten in their last 18 Premier League games when ahead at half-time, dating back to December 2021 against West Ham and including five wins and a draw when leading at the break this season.
Madueke scorches down the right and shrugs off Palhinha before crossing, but Adarabioyo's there again to make the block and concede a corner.
SAVED!!! Pereira's smart run from Robinson's pass out of defence opens up a chance for Fulham, and his cut-back across the Chelsea box finds Jimenez.
He shoots first-time with the ball heading for the bottom corner, but Petrovic gets down well to claw it away!
SAVED!! Jimenez chests down a cross-field Willian pass and shoots on the half-volley, but Petrovic is there to make the save at his near post!

Caicedo chops down Pereira on the edge of Chelsea's box and out comes the yellow card from the referee's pocket - but it's instead for Disasi, who booted the ball away to prevent Fulham taking a quick free-kick!
OVER!!! Pereira lines up the free-kick and shoots from 20 yards, but there's just a tad too much power behind the effort and it flashes over the crossbar!
Sterling's been one of Chelsea's main attacking outlets so far in this game, but comes off now for Ben Chilwell's first league appearance in months for the Blues.
It's a change that could well see the hosts shift into a back three or five.

Fulham concede a corner but break away from it almost straight away, and after Jimenez knocks the ball over halfway and beyond Silva, he's clipped by the Brazilian and the veteran Chelsea centre-back goes into the book.
There was a fair bit of acrimony towards the referee following that illegally-thwarted Fulham break, and Chelsea's goalscorer Palmer is also shown a yellow at the conclusion of the argument.
Fulham break out from another corner and Jimenez spots a backtracking Petrovic off his line.
He goes for goal from behind the halfway line, but gets his long-range attempt all wrong and the Chelsea keeper can stop the effort with his feet!
Another two changes coming for Fulham, as Pereira comes off to be replaced in the attacking line by Rodrigo Muniz.
Sasa Lukic also enters the fray for the Cottagers, replacing the ever-busy Palhinha in the heart of their midfield.

POST!!! Chelsea strike the upright once again!! Madueke's byline cross is blocked into the path of Gallagher, whose outside of the foot shot looks destined for goal until rattling back off the far post!
Robinson drifts in-field and beats Gusto to pop up on the edge of the box.
His snap-shot from just inside the area is blocked, but Fulham will get another bite of the cherry after the referee awards them a free-kick for Colwill's foul on Muniz!
OVER!!! With Wilson and Pereira off, it's Willian who steps up for Fulham against his old club.
He zips the free-kick over the wall and engages Petrovic, but the shot is always rising and whistles over the top of his crossbar!
Despite having 26 touches in Fulham's box throughout this second half, Chelsea are yet to have a shot on target.
The Blues are still on course for victory though, and have lost just two of their last 201 Premier League home games when winning at half-time - both defeats coming against Arsenal.
The board goes up and signals for FIVE additional minutes at Stamford Bridge - will we see some game-defining action beyond the 90 here?
SAVED!!! Gallagher drives towards the edge of Fulham's box before setting Madueke up to shoot, and his low drive towards the bottom corner draws a last-ditch save from Leno at full stretch!
Palmer's goal remains the difference for Chelsea in the dying moments of this game, and he's replaced very late in the day by Carney Chukwuemeka.
Youngster Alfie Gilchrist is also brought off for the final throws in this cauldron-like atmosphere, and replaces Gusto at right-back.
De Cordova-Reid gets caught between challenges from Chilwell and Colwill to win Fulham a free-kick on the right-hand side.
It's now or never for the Cottagers to rescue something here!

BLOCKED!!!! The free-kick from Willian headed back across the face of goal by Muniz, but De Cordova-Reid, sliding in at the far post, sends his desperate shot into the back of his own team-mate Adarabioyo! Cairney hits a rebound effort from the edge of the box, but that too is blocked as Chelsea continue to hang on!

Another late Fulham free-kick is swung in by Willian, sparking chaos and pinball in the box, but the visitors just can't get a clean shot away and it's launched clear by Chelsea just as the final whistle sounds!
FULL-TIME: CHELSEA 1-0 FULHAM.

It's all over at Stamford Bridge, and that late first-half penalty from Palmer seals the points for Chelsea in this fiercely contested west London Derby! The chances continued in spades as the second half wore on, with Sterling and Gallagher both hitting the woodwork as the Blues went within inches of doubling their lead.
Palmer and Colwill both struck wide, while further shots from Broja and Madueke being blocked and saved respectively by Leno and the Fulham defence.

Up at the other end, Jimenez drew two stops from Petrovic in quick succession, while Pereira and Willian both put close-range free-kicks over the bar as the Cottagers missed the chance to close the four-point gap between themselves and their London rivals.

That's now four home wins on the bounce for Chelsea in the league, and they climb to eighth in the table with a performance that will give Mauricio Pochettino reassurance and confidence in the progress his side is making.
